record.question: Which of the following is the most common therapeutic modality for ESRD (end stage renal disease):
record.explanation: Answer A: Hemodialysis. Hemodialysis is the most commonly used kidney-replacement modality in many national datasets; the stem says “most common” without defining geography or year, but it is the conventional answer among listed choices. Reference: https://usrds-adr.niddk.nih.gov/2025/end-stage-renal-disease/6-incidence-prevalence-mortality-and-treatment-modalities. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
